newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ara, Tekchem float stock on Mexican market.
newsitem.headline: Ara, Tekchem float stock on Mexican market.

text.p: Construction group Ara and chemical firm Tekchem both launched initial public offerings in the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV) on Thursday and Ara also issued global shares.

Ara intended to issue a total of 20,479,348 shares simultaneously, equivalent to 19.6 percent of its shareholding capital, in a global placement in Mexico and abroad, at a unit price of 16 pesos. Ara planned to offer 6,143,804 shares in Mexico and 1,433,554 ADSs, each equivalent to 10 ordinary shares, in the United States.
Tekchem will meanwhile offer 34.9 million A series shares, or 30.35 percent of its shareholding capital, at 2.85 pesos each.
Ara granted its underwriting agents, brokerage houses Bancomer and Salomon Brothers, options to acquire 921,571 shares and 215,033 ADSs, respectively.
Tekchem's underwriting agent was Abaco brokerage.
